notes: Plan 7 Track C: the class abilities of combat design §5, played in a fight through the 1–9 slots (combat/abilities.ts). Each has 1 use a long rest from the level it is gained and 1 more at levels 6, 10, 14 and 18 (ABILITY_USE_LEVELS); Lay on Hands is a pool of 5 HP a level instead, and Smite spends one of the paladin's spell uses (its dice + 1d8 a spell level above 1). Uses come back on a long rest (a day's rest in camp or at an inn). Levels: even levels bring abilities (the first at level 1). A fighter picks a style at levels 4, 8, 12 and 16 (+2 damage on each attack of that kind of full action, STYLE_DAMAGE); a bard specialises one of their six songs at levels 4, 8, 12, 16 and 20 (`specialised`: a bigger die or heal, and SPECIALISE_USES more uses of it). Designer call 2026-11-14: in lieu of spells, the bard has a fifth and sixth song, Mending Song (one member) and Song of Renewal (the party, smaller); each song keeps its own uses. Saves are against 8 + proficiency + the casting ability (ABILITY_DC_BASE). Rogues' Sneak Attack, and the wizard's and cleric's spells, come later.

entries.name: Second Wind
entries.description: A breath, a grunt, and the fighter is back in it: heals 1d10 + level.

entries.name: Action Surge
entries.description: One more push: after acting, the fighter may act again this turn.

entries.name: Cunning Action
entries.description: Up to two quick steps instead of one, slipping out of reach without a free swing. The rogue can still attack.

entries.name: Lay on Hands
entries.description: A healing touch on a member on the paladin's tile or the next, from a pool of 5 HP a level each long rest.

entries.name: Smite
entries.description: A weapon blow charged with radiant force: 2d8 more on a hit (1d8 more for each spell level above 1), spending a spell use.

entries.name: Mark
entries.description: The ranger marks one foe: their hits on it deal 1d6 more for the rest of the fight.

entries.name: Turn Undead
entries.description: The holy symbol raised: each undead on two tiles (from 1–3 away) saves WIS or flees in fear for 3 rounds.

entries.name: Inspire
entries.description: A word or a few bars for one member up to 3 tiles away: +1d6 to their attack rolls this round.

specialised.description: +1d8 to their attack rolls this round.

entries.name: Mending Song
entries.description: A low, steadying song for one member up to 3 tiles away: heals 1d8 + level.

entries.name: Cutting Words
entries.description: A jibe that lands where it hurts: one foe up to 6 tiles away has −1d6 on its attacks this round.

entries.name: Rallying Song
entries.description: A marching song: every member still fighting has +2 to hit this round.

specialised.description: +2 to hit and +2 damage this round.

entries.name: Song of Renewal
entries.description: A song the whole party breathes with: one roll heals every member still fighting 1d6 + half the level.

specialised.description: Heals every member 2d6 + half the level.

entries.name: Discord
entries.description: A sour, maddening tune at one tile 1–4 away: the enemies there break off their plans and fall back, or turn on each other (−4) if they can't.
